content:
Linh and Tuan are friends who love films. Today, Linh has some exciting news.

She asks, "Have you heard about the new cinema in Cau Giay? It's the one where the screens are as big as a house!"
"Really? Is that the cinema which opened last week?"
"Yes. My cousin went there on Sunday, and she loved it. The seats are so comfortable that you can almost sleep in them."
"That sounds great. What's on?"
"There's a new Vietnamese action film that everyone is talking about. There might be no tickets left tonight, though."
Tuan opens the cinema's app. "The seven o'clock show has no seats left. That film must be very popular."
"What about the nine o'clock show?"
"There are a few seats in the front row. Those can't be very good. You have to look up for two hours."
"Hmm. Is there a show tomorrow?"
"Yes, at six. There are lots of seats in the middle."
"Let's take two in the middle. Who's the actor who plays the main character?"
"It's Thanh Son, the man whose film we watched last month."
"Oh, I liked him. This film must be good too."
Tuan says, "Done! I've bought the tickets. The cinema is next to a restaurant where they make great pizza. Shall we eat there first?"
"Perfect. My treat this time."

grammarNote.title: Mệnh đề quan hệ (who, which, that, whose, where)
grammarNote.bodyVi: Mệnh đề quan hệ mô tả nơi chốn, phim và người: the one where the screens are as big as a house (where – nơi chốn), the cinema which opened last week (which – vật), a film that everyone is talking about (that – vật), the actor who plays the main character (who – người), the man whose film we watched (whose – sở hữu), a restaurant where they make great pizza. Bài cũng đoán bằng might / must / can't.
examples: It's the one where the screens are as big as a house!"
Is that the cinema which opened last week?"
"It's Thanh Son, the man whose film we watched last month."

grammarStep.titleVi: Mệnh đề quan hệ (who, which, that, whose, where)

noticing.sentence: Linh and Tuan are friends who love films.
It's the one where the screens are as big as a house!"
Is that the cinema which opened last week?"
The cinema is next to a restaurant where they make great pizza.

grammarStep.questionVi: Vì sao nói "the cinema which opened" nhưng "the one where the screens are"?
options: Which thay cho "the cinema" làm chủ ngữ; where nghĩa là "ở rạp đó".
Vì which dùng cho quá khứ, where dùng cho hiện tại.
Hai câu dùng thay nhau được.
grammarStep.explanationVi: The cinema which opened = rạp (nó) mở cửa. The one where the screens are big = rạp mà ở đó màn chiếu rất to (where = in which).
grammarStep.whenVi: Dùng where khi muốn nói điều gì xảy ra ở một nơi; dùng which / that khi nơi đó tự làm chủ ngữ hoặc tân ngữ.

table.subject: which (vật làm chủ ngữ)
table.form: the cinema which opened last week

table.subject: where (ở nơi đó)
table.form: a restaurant where they make great pizza

table.subject: whose (sở hữu)
table.form: the man whose film we watched

mistakes.wrong: It's a restaurant which they make great pizza.
mistakes.right: It's a restaurant where they make great pizza.

mistakes.wrong: Is that the cinema where opened last week?
mistakes.right: Is that the cinema which opened last week?

grammarStep.noteVi: Sau where luôn có chủ ngữ riêng (they make, the screens are). Nếu không có chủ ngữ, dùng which / that.

exercises.promptVi: Sắp xếp các từ thành câu đúng.

exercises.explanationVi: Nơi chốn có chủ ngữ riêng: where; từ "which" bị thừa.

writingHelp.grammarLabelVi: Có ít nhất 1 mệnh đề quan hệ (who, which, that, whose, where)
outlineVi: Nơi đó là gì, ở đâu (a place where …).
Điều gì đặc biệt (It has seats that … / a cook who …).
Ai đã giới thiệu cho bạn (my friend who …), và bạn đoán vì sao nó nổi tiếng (It must …).
writingHelp.modelAnswer: There is a small cinema in my town where they show old films every Friday night. My friend Hoa, who loves old films, told me about it last year. It has red seats that are very comfortable, and there is a café where you can buy hot drinks. It must be popular, because the Friday shows are always full.
